## Verification status

**All 10 repos verified live at capture (GitHub API: existence, stars, created/pushed dates, license).** No hallucinated repos in this list — the aggregator did his homework.

- **Framing caveats:** "免费" (free) needs nuance — HyperFrames (HeyGen), Nango (VC-backed, $12M+ raised), and Fincept are **commercial open-source** (company-owned, cloud upsell), not community toys. Fincept and Nango carry non-OSI custom licenses (NOASSERTION) — check terms before commercial use.
- **Dormant item:** cloudflare/agentic-inbox was a 2-week hack (created 2026-04-10, last push 2026-04-23) — likely an experiment Cloudflare stopped tending. Treat as inspiration, not infrastructure.
- **Category noise:** TradingAgents (105.6k★) is a research framework, not a "subscription killer" — nothing on most people's invoice maps to it. The tweet's framing overreaches for 2-3 items; the core claim (self-hostable replacements for chat UI, integrations, TTS, video) is solid.

## Why it matters

- **Direct hits on live company workstreams:** **Nango** is the leading open-source candidate behind the vault's "Hermes connector layer for all emails/accounts with per-connector permissions" research; **agentic-inbox** is a working reference architecture for the Inbox Assistant mandate (self-hosted, per-account, agent-in-the-loop — same shape, needs a maintained fork or rebuild); **agent-skills** feeds directly into the agent/skills practice already running here (Theo tip, scope-guard, cyclomatic-complexity, ponytail).
- **Catalog value > individual items:** the durable lesson is the *pattern* — before renewing any SaaS subscription, grep GitHub for the open-source pole. The 23.9k bookmarks say others file it the same way.
- **Media trio for later:** HyperFrames + MoneyPrinterTurbo + VoxCPM together cover programmatic video + voice at $0 — worth a spike only when a concrete content need exists (default: no action).
- **Isolation note (CoS convention):** TradingAgents is trading-adjacent; captured here as knowledge only — nothing routed to the trading company.
